messages:
customer_acme: Hey team — our org org-824 dropped to 0 credits at ~02:12 UTC but our monthly refill is due at 03:00 UTC. We started getting 429s on production and a few background jobs failed. Dashboard still shows 0. Example request ids: r_9a1f, r_9a2b. Any idea?

maya_support: sorry to hear that — can you confirm org id (posted) and which plan you're on? any chance you saw a large spike before 02:00?

customer_acme: plan is Team-Pro monthly. No big spike from our side — just steady traffic. We do have 3 long-lived websocket streams for realtime inference.

jake_eng: thanks. can you paste one full request payload or curl for r_9a1f? and were the websocket streams still connected when you saw 429s?

customer_acme: websocket sessions were open. here's a minimal repro for a single REST call we used (obf keys):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.xxxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neox-20b","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":256}'
```

infra-bot: Billing-migration job `shard-reconcile-2026-03-15` started at 02:05 UTC on billing-shard-3.

chris_billing: we ran a scheduled shard reconciliation earlier this window. it was meant to be read-only, but I'm seeing a cleanup step that can apply deltas to per-org counters if a tombstone is found — that's not intended. tagging @ops_lee @jake_eng

jake_eng: looking at logs — there is a window where counter writes were enabled for shard-3 during the cutover (02:07–02:14 UTC). I can see writes that decrement org-824's token bucket with `source=shard_cleanup`. that explains the drop to zero before the monthly refill.

maya_support: is this a one-off or could other tenants be impacted?

jake_eng: seems limited to the affected shard and only when the reconcile detects an out-of-order tombstone. low probability but non-zero.

ops_lee: mitigation plan: 1) pause the cleanup step on other shards; 2) run a backfill to restore any incorrect debits; 3) add a guard so cleanup never touches active org buckets. I'll coordinate.

chris_billing: headed to run backfill now. we will compute delta per org from pre-cutover snapshot and apply compensating credits.

ops_lee: applied compensating credits to org-824 at 05:20 UTC (+25,000 tokens). audit log: AUDIT-20260315-8892.

customer_acme: confirmed — credits are back, dashboard reflects new balance, and our jobs resumed. thanks for the quick turnaround.

maya_support: closing the support blockage for now. we'll open INC-2026-1145 for the shard-reconcile bug and schedule a postmortem and a customer SLA credit. chris_billing/jake_eng to own follow-up.

jake_eng: plan for postmortem: root cause is a reconciliation script enabling writes during cutover. actions: add explicit read-only flag, add unit test, and deploy patch to reconciliation service.

chris_billing: also adding a billing check that flags large unexpected decrements > X tokens within a 10m window for manual review.

customer_acme: appreciate the fast help. please keep us posted in INC-2026-1145 and DM if you need more logs.

maya_support: will do. :thumbsup:
